known_gaps: Candidate field annotations incomplete; inherited omissions must be fixed
No independent gold approval or calibrated pass thresholds
Current images are official blank PDFs, not filled real scans/photos
Actual rendered SVG overlap/overflow evaluation not implemented
Difficulty rubric and existing candidate tier assignments require review
Some reference glyphs remain PDF outlines; text metric misses those
Model-generated field geometry is declared, not proof of actual rendered layout
Internal target wheel/font compatibility not yet verified
SVG repeat diagnostics are aggregated but correlated repeats are not independent; final pass calibration absent
Text-anchor matching excludes transformed or path-only glyphs; visual pixel metric is font-sensitive
V3 requires reviewed per-image table_regions.json and ignore masks for filled originals
GriTS requires cell annotations and optional grits-metric; not a default V3 aggregate component
Harness P2 requires a model accepting at least 2 images in a chat; some vLLM served models need --limit-mm-per-prompt adjusted
Visual-only P2 feedback without reviewed table ROI is an uncalibrated proxy and must not be combined with official V3 results
Two SVG bench entry points exist: formgen/bench.py (pass-rate table, v1 pass rule) and svg_cli bench (v2/v3 diagnostic means, no resume); consolidate once the v2/v3 scorers are calibrated
Three scorer generations (v1, v2, v3) coexist; which one defines 'pass' is undecided
Multi-page input not implemented; P2 exists only in the harness, not in the pass-rate bench
Pass rule is provisional; text_r is used because references have outlined glyphs
shift_far selftest case is skipped on current items (no room to move fields 30% of page width)
bench/official_gold_v1 has no ref.svg; overlaps 3 pilot forms
No multi-model comparison table; each bench run reports one model
Redistribution rights of official PDFs not established
